== 2026 championship update (Story 386) ==

The official Retro catalog establishes the four published places: Will Tarbox, Alex Prodoehl, Jeremy Christoffel and Zach Stenerson. Added those places while retaining all eight deck links. The four published players are not presented as a verified attendance count. The weekend date remains distinct from the unresolved exact playing date. Replaced the unsolved-winner request with the sourced result. Removed the redundant eight-post source list; those sources remain on the individual deck articles. Both catalog references have opened, byte-checked Internet Archive captures.

== Signed promotional card (22 November 2026) ==

Added a photograph of a sleeved "2026 World Championships" promotional card in a new Memorabilia section. The same file was already on the wiki as [[:File:2026 World Championship signed card.jpg]] (Holocron Claude, 22 November 2026; sourced to a 28 October 2026 post in the SWCCG Discord #retro-league-pc) and is also in the Photographs gallery on [[2026 World Championship]].

Signature transcription, top to bottom, as the ink appears: Jeremy Christoffel (black; the surname ends in a cursive flourish), Marty McFly (green, as written), Will Tarbox (blue), and ZACH Stevenson (purple, as written). The purple signature's spelling differs from [[Zach Stenerson]], who finished fourth at this event. The green signature is transcribed as written and is not identified further here.
